source: It’s fine! The shuttle just arrived anyway.
translation: 没关系！穿梭巴士反正刚到。

source: They prefer to hang out with their friends – and that’s a good thing.
translation: 他们更喜欢和朋友待在一起——这可是件好事。

source: You were sleeping like a baby, so we didn’t want to bother you, hehe.
translation: 你睡得像个婴儿，所以我们不想打扰你，嘿嘿。

source: If that’s the case, then I suppose I’ll share a room with you, Yoshinori.
translation: 如果是这样，那我想我就和你同住一个房间吧，Yoshinori。

source: Oh! Of course, sir!
translation: 哦！当然，先生！

source: Aww, dammit! You beat me to it, Gramps!
translation: 哎呀，可恶！你抢先了，Gramps！

source: Does that leave me sharing rooms with you-know-who…?
translation: 那我是不是要和“你懂的那个人”一起住……？

source: Hmph, bold of you to assume I want to share a room with the likes of you!
translation: 哼，真敢假设我想和你这种人同住！

source: Well, we don’t mind sharing a room with Aiden. Right, Dar?
translation: 没关系，我们不介意和Aiden同住。对吧，Dar？

source: *splutters* WHAT?!
translation: *噗* 什么？！

source: Besides, Aiden knows how to have a good time~!
translation: 再说，Aiden知道怎么让大家玩得开心~！

source: I’m reconsidering my decision…
translation: 我重新考虑我的决定了……

source: Well, the room can fit one more~ Think you can handle three guys at the same time, Jin?
translation: 房间还可以再住一个人~你觉得自己能同时应付三个男人吗，Jin？

source: Okay, you’re in – I-I mean, I’m in.
translation: 好吧，你加入——我、我是说，我加入。

source: Goodbye, Yuri.
translation: 再见，Yuri。

source: WAIT, NO! Let me come with you guys!!!
translation: 等等，不行！让我和你们一起去！！！

source: Screw the other room! I’ll sleep on the floor! You won’t even know I’m there!
translation: 去他妈的另一个房间！我睡地板就行！你们根本不会发现我在！

source: No, Yuri. To your room. NOW.
translation: 不行，Yuri。回你的房间。现在。

source: DO I LOOK LIKE I CARE?! There’s no way I’ll miss all of the action!!
translation: 你觉得我在乎吗？！我绝对不会错过全部好戏！！

source: Haha, didn’t work this time, Gramps.
translation: 哈哈，这次没用，Gramps。

source: Heehheehhe… And me, their willing subject…
translation: 嘿嘿嘿嘿……而我，是他们自愿的实验对象……

source: Wait, what?
translation: 等等，什么？

source: Maybe it’s a bad idea if Yuri and Jin stay with you guys…? They’ll pass out way too often…
translation: 如果Yuri和Jin和你们一起住，也许不是个好主意……？他们会太频繁地晕倒……

source: *sigh* If that’s the case…
translation: *叹气* 如果是这样……

source: Hyunjin!
translation: Hyunjin！

source: Escort Yuri to her room. Stay with her and keep her out of trouble. No objections.
translation: 护送Yuri回她的房间。陪着她，别让她惹麻烦。不许反对。

source: Y-Yes, Daddy! I mean… Sir Goro!
translation: 是、是的，爸爸！我是说……Goro先生！

source: NOOOOOOOoooooooo!!!
Ooh, clever using some powerplay, Gramps~
translation: 哦哦，利用权力游戏，聪明啊，Gramps~

source: They wouldn’t get so worked up if you hadn’t pushed their buttons, Aiden.
translation: 如果不是你一直挑衅他们，他们也不会这么激动，Aiden。

source: Hehe. Aiden always adds fuel to the fire.
translation: 嘿嘿。Aiden总是火上浇油。

source: I do what I do best.
translation: 我只是在做我最擅长的事。

source: Come on, guys! Quit the chit-chat and let’s check out what our room looks like!
translation: 来吧，大家！别闲聊了，去看看我们的房间是什么样！

source: Right behind ’ya!
translation: 马上来！

source: Yeah. I’d rather her act like this than be stressed about Emilia.
translation: 是啊。比起为Emilia烦恼，我宁愿她就这样。

source: I actually thought you’d be bunking with Yuri though, sir. Since she’s your daughter after all.
translation: 我其实以为你会和Yuri同住，先生。毕竟她是你的女儿。

source: Oh, come on, don’t use the father card on me…
translation: 哎呀，别拿父亲身份压我……

source: And don’t pretend like you wouldn’t be jealous if I didn’t stay with you.
translation: 别装作如果我不和你住你不会嫉妒。

source: *ehem* Anyway, let’s head to our room.
translation: *呃咳* 总之，我们去房间吧。

source: Yes, sir…!
translation: 好的，先生……！

source: Whoa…
I guess I shouldn’t be surprised, but the room is luxurious too.
translation: 我想我不该惊讶，但房间也很豪华。

source: Just look at that view, it’s like we’re in the sky.
translation: 看看那景色，就像我们在天空中。

source: Heh… Booking us a penthouse room in the most expensive hotel in the city. Mr. Clermont really went overboard with this one.
translation: 呵……在城市最昂贵的酒店给我们订顶层套房。Clermont先生这次真是大手笔。

source: I bet the facilities included in our package will be just as extravagant.  I can’t wait to try them with you.
translation: 我敢说套餐里包含的设施也会同样奢华。我迫不及待想和你一起试试。

source: What’s with that look, Yoshinori?
translation: 你那是什么表情，Yoshinori？

source: O-Oh, I’m sorry, sir! I totally spaced out… I just realized that—
translation: 哦、哦，对不起，先生！我刚才完全走神了……我只是意识到——

source: O-Oh, I’m sorry, sir! I totally spaced out… I just realized that—{fast}
translation: 哦、哦，对不起，先生！我刚才完全走神了……我只是意识到——{fast}

source: All of this is new to me.
translation: 这一切对我来说都是全新的。

source: All of this is actually new to me. I’m so out of my element.
translation: 这一切对我来说确实很新鲜。我完全不适应。

source: I’ve gotten used to being surrounded by trees and staying in wooden cabins all the time.
translation: 我已经习惯了身边都是树，一直住在木屋里。

source: Compared to Camp Buddy, this is a completely different world.
translation: 和 Camp Buddy 相比，这完全是另一个世界。

source: Heh… You’ve always been the country kind of guy, Yoshinori. It’s about time you get a taste of city life.
translation: 呵……你一直是个乡下人，Yoshinori。也该让你尝尝城市生活了。

source: On that note, why don’t we go out and try something already? I’ve got this hotel brochure from earlier, so let’s take a look.
translation: 说到这个，我们为什么不出去试试？我之前拿了这家酒店的宣传册，来看看吧。

source: I'm on a vacation with my boss.
translation: 我和我的老板一起在度假。

source: I’m on a vacation with my boss…
translation: 我和我的老板一起在度假……

source: I don’t see the issue here.
translation: 我没看出这有什么问题。

source: More importantly, just relax around me. We’re not here for work.
translation: 更重要的是，在我身边放松点。我们不是来工作的。

source: That’s all you’ve been focusing on the past few months, and you deserve a break.
translation: 过去几个月你一直只顾着工作，你值得休息一下。

source: I guess…
translation: 我想……

source: Well, let’s get started doing something to get work off your mind! Check out this hotel brochure I got.
translation: 好了，我们开始做点事情，把工作抛到脑后！看看我拿到的酒店宣传册。

source: I don't even know where to start.
translation: 我甚至不知道该从哪里开始。

source: I-I don’t even know where to start.
translation: 我、我甚至不知道该从哪里开始。

source: It sounds like there’ll be so many new things to try out here…!
translation: 听起来这里有好多新东西可以尝试……！

source: Hahaha!  You’ve always been the country kind of guy, Yoshinori. It’ll really be interesting to see you get a taste of city life.
translation: 哈哈哈！你一直是个乡下人，Yoshinori。看你尝尝城市生活一定很有意思。

source: Ahehe… Compared to Camp Buddy, this is a completely different world.
translation: 啊哈哈……和 Camp Buddy 相比，这完全是另一个世界。

source: Which makes it more exciting don’t you think?
translation: 这不是让一切更令人兴奋了吗？

source: Y-Yeah! Although, I’m totally clueless about what kind of activities there are here…
translation: 是、是啊！不过，我完全不知道这里有什么活动……

source: Well, why don’t we go and try something out? Take a look at this brochure.
translation: 那我们为什么不去试试？看看这本宣传册。

source: There's only one bed...
translation: 这里只有一张床……

source: There’s only one bed…
translation: 这里只有一张床……

source: Oh. I didn’t even notice that.
translation: 哦。我刚才甚至没注意到。

source: But don’t worry, I’m pretty sure we’ll fit together.
translation: 不过别担心，我很确定我们挤得下。

source: Ah, well… That’s exactly it…
translation: 啊，这个嘛……正是这样……

source: Sounds to me like you’re imagining something else! Can’t wait til’ the evening?
translation: 听起来你是在想别的事情！等不及到晚上了吗？

source: G-GAH—
translation: 啊、啊——

source: HAHAHA! We’ve been staying in the same cabin for months now, Yoshinori! This isn’t that new!
translation: 哈哈哈！我们在同一间木屋住了几个月，Yoshinori！这没什么新鲜的！

source: B-But not in the same bed, sir…!
translation: 但、但不是同一张床，先生……！

source: Save it for later, and check out this hotel brochure I got.
translation: 留到之后吧，先看看我拿到的酒店宣传册。

source: Whoa… This place really has everything… You could live like royalty for the rest of your life if you had the money to stay here…
translation: 哇……这个地方真的应有尽有……如果有钱住在这里，你可以像皇室一样过完余生……

source: And all of this is free. It’s all part of the package Mr. Clermont got for us.
translation: 而且这一切都是免费的。这些都是Clermont先生给我们安排的套餐内容。

source: There’s a bar, café, gym, and so much more… I can’t even pick…
translation: 有酒吧、咖啡馆、健身房，还有更多……我根本没法选……

source: Don’t worry, Yoshinori. There’s plenty of time for us to try everything out.
translation: 别担心，Yoshinori。我们有足够的时间把一切都试一遍。

source: For now, leave it to me. I know exactly where we should go.
translation: 现在交给我吧。我知道我们该去哪里。

source: Whew… It’s really nice here, sir.
translation: 呼……这里真不错，先生。

source: I figured you’d enjoy it, especially after that long bus ride.
translation: 我就知道你会喜欢，尤其是在坐了那么久的巴士之后。

source: Yeah… I can’t remember the last time I took an actual bath… We only have showers back at the camp, after all.
translation: 是啊……我都不记得上次真正泡澡是什么时候了……毕竟营地里只有淋浴。

source: Exactly. I’m calling it already – this will be my favorite part of the day.
translation: 没错。我现在就宣布了——这会是我一天中最喜欢的部分。

source: It’s been a while since I’ve seen you smile that wide, Sir Goro.
translation: 我已经有一阵子没见你笑得这么开心了，Goro先生。

source: I can’t help it. You know how I love going to places like this.
translation: 没办法。你知道我多喜欢来这种地方。

source: Haha, yeah! I remember that you’d make it a point to go to the local sauna once a week when I was a scout.
translation: 哈哈，是啊！我记得我还是童军时，你每周都会特意去一次当地的桑拿。

source: I still do, but between the last term and this project, there’s not really been any chance.
translation: 我现在还是会去，但上一期活动和这个项目之间，实在没有机会。

source: It’s how I usually release all the stress and soreness from working the entire week. I’m not getting any younger after all.
translation: 这是我一周工作下来释放压力、缓解酸痛的惯常方式。毕竟我也不年轻了。

source: Besides, I only go to public bathhouses or small massage places. They’re nothing compared to this one.
translation: 再说，我只去公共澡堂或小型按摩店。它们和这里完全没法比。

source: Heh, in here, I feel like I’m a king in his royal chambers!
translation: 呵，在这里，我感觉自己像是皇家浴室里的国王！

source: I mean… Just look at this place, what other bathhouses have you seen with waiters going around delivering you drinks?
translation: 我的意思是……看看这里，其他澡堂哪会有服务员到处给你送饮料？

source: Yeah, even the water feels expensive… It’s kinda sparkly and it smells like flowers…
translation: 是啊，连水都感觉很贵……有点闪闪发光，还有花香……

source: Not to mention it’s really spacious, even considering how many guests are in here.
translation: 更不用说这里非常宽敞，即使考虑到里面有这么多客人。

source: Speaking of space, why are you sitting so far over there?
translation: 说到空间，你为什么坐得那么远？

source: Scoot a little closer, will you?
translation: 坐近一点，好吗？

source: A-Ah…! Yes, sir…!
translation: 啊、啊……！好的，先生……！

source: That’s more like it.
translation: 这样就对了。

source: You know, this is exactly what I was looking forward to as soon as I found out we were going on a vacation.
translation: 你知道吗，从得知我们要来度假开始，这正是我一直期待的。

source: After grinding for months, wearing our bodies out day and night, we really deserve this.
translation: 辛苦了几个月，日夜操劳，我们确实值得这个。

source: Just the two of us, relaxing… without a single care in the world…
translation: 只有我们两个人，放松……不必担心世上的任何事……

source: {i}(I’m barely hearing Sir Goro’s words… Being so close to him is too distracting!){/i}
translation: {i}（我几乎没在听Goro先生说什么……离他这么近实在太让人分心了！）{/i}

source: {i}(The fact we’re in this kind of setting isn’t helping either… I can’t keep my eyes off of his—){/i}
translation: {i}（在这种场合也没有帮助……我的目光根本无法从他的——）{/i}

source: YOSHINORI.
translation: YOSHINORI。

source: G-GAH…! Wh-Wha?!
translation: 啊——！什、什么？！

source: Why are you so jittery? Your back’s hunched and your muscles are all tensed up.
translation: 你为什么这么坐立不安？你的背弓着，肌肉全都绷紧了。

source: And you aren’t listening to what I’m saying, are you?
translation: 而且你根本没在听我说话，对吧？

source: I-I’m sorry, sir!
translation: 对、对不起，先生！

source: *sigh* You don’t have to be so polite.  We’re not at camp anymore.
translation: *叹气* 不用这么客气。我们已经不在营地了。

source: A-Ah… I didn’t mean to.
translation: 啊、啊……我不是故意的。

source: I just want you to be as comfortable around me as you were back then.
translation: 我只是希望你能像过去一样，在我身边感到自在。

source: Like… when I was a scout?
translation: 就像……我还是童子军的时候？

source: Yeah. Our dynamic was still the same, with me being your superior, but you still managed to always be your carefree self.
translation: 是啊。虽然我仍然是你的上级，我们的关系也没变，但你总能保持无忧无虑的自己。

source: Th-That was a long time ago, sir…
translation: 那、那已经是很久以前了，先生……

source: Things have changed since then, I know. But I really do miss it.
translation: 从那以后很多事情都变了，我知道。但我真的很怀念那段时光。

source: Good day, fine gentlemen~! Enjoying your time here at Spa Ankhme~?
translation: 下午好，两位绅士~！在安克梅水疗中心过得愉快吗~？

source: I hope I’m not interrupting an intimate moment, but may I interest you in some drinks?
translation: 希望没有打扰你们的亲密时刻，不过要不要来点饮料？

source: No, we’re good.
translation: 不用了，我们很好。

source: How about a massage? We take pride in our quality ‘extra service’ with guaranteed ‘happy endings!’
translation: 要不要按摩？我们以高品质的“额外服务”为傲，并保证“快乐结局”！

source: It’s fine. We prefer to relax by ourselves.
translation: 没关系。我们更喜欢自己放松。

source: Oh, we have just the perfect thing! May I offer a private sauna room to such a lovely couple~?
translation: 哦，我们正好有最完美的东西！要不要为这么可爱的一对提供私人桑拿房~？

source: Oh, we have just the perfect thing! May I offer a private sauna room to such a lovely couple~?{fast}
translation: 哦，我们正好有最完美的东西！要不要为这么可爱的一对提供私人桑拿房~？{fast}

source: We're not.
translation: 我们不是。

source: Oh, I apologize for my assumption.
translation: 哦，抱歉，是我误会了。

source: He's my boss.
translation: 他是我的老板。

source: A-Ah! Please don’t get the wrong idea, he’s my boss…!
translation: 啊！请别误会，他是我的老板……！

source: Oh, my apologies. It really looked like something else.
translation: 哦，抱歉。看起来确实像另一回事。

source: It's not up to me.
translation: 这不是我能决定的。

source: W-Well… it’s not up to me.
translation: 嗯……这不是我能决定的。

source: Sir Goro.
translation: Goro先生。

source: Uhh… Sir Goro?
translation: 呃……Goro先生？

source: We’ll take the room.
translation: 我们要这个房间。

source: It should be right along the hallway! Please follow m—
translation: 应该就在走廊那边！请跟我来——

source: Thanks, but there’s no need to escort us.
translation: 谢谢，但不用你带路。

source: Come with me, Yoshinori.
translation: 跟我来，Yoshinori。

source: S-Sir Goro…! Y-You’re…
translation: Goro先生……！你……你要……

source: Take it and let’s get you loosened up.
translation: 拿上它，让我帮你放松。

source: Have a wonderful time, you two~
translation: 祝你们两位玩得愉快~

source: Hey, there. Where were those two headed? I think I know them.
translation: 嘿，你好。那两个人去哪儿了？我觉得我认识他们。

source: Oh! I just booked them a private room!
translation: 哦！我刚给他们订了一间私人房！

source: Ah, alright, never mind then.
translation: 啊，好吧，那没事了。

source: Hold on, maybe you’d like one as well? I’ve got another key here.
translation: 等等，也许你也想要一间？我这里还有一把钥匙。

source: Oh, really? If there’s one available, sure.
translation: 哦，真的吗？如果有空房，当然。

source: Of course~ It’s my pleasure, hehe.
translation: 当然~这是我的荣幸，嘿嘿。

source: Wow, we’ve got this sauna to ourselves? I guess I shouldn’t be so surprised since everything else is so fancy…
translation: 哇，我们可以独享这个桑拿房？既然其他一切都这么豪华，我想我不该惊讶……

source: Let’s make the most of it then.
translation: 那我们就好好利用它。

source: Come, Yoshinori. Sit next to me.
translation: 来，Yoshinori。坐到我旁边。

source: Lock the door first.
translation: 先把门锁上。

source: Sit down and let loose.(DLC)
translation: 坐下，放松。(DLC)

source: S-Sure thing, Sir! Let me just lock the door first.
translation: 好、好的，先生！让我先把门锁上。

source: There we go.
translation: 好了。

source: Feeling warm, Yoshinori?
translation: 感觉暖和吗，Yoshinori？

source: Y-Yes, sir...
translation: 是、是的，先生……

source: Just relax your body and feel the wood on your back…
translation: 放松身体，感受背后的木头……

source: {i}(My chest is pounding thanks to all the dirty thoughts swimming in my head…){/i}
translation: {i}（我脑中满是下流的想法，胸口因为它们而怦怦直跳……）{/i}

source: {i}(It doesn’t help that I got a peek at that giant thing of his… It makes me want to put it in my…){/i}
translation: {i}（更别说我还偷瞄到了他那巨大的东西……这让我想把它放进我的……）{/i}

source: Feeling thirsty?
translation: 口渴吗？

source: You know you could’ve just asked…
translation: 你其实可以直接说……

source: Wh-Wha?
translation: 什、什么？

source: You’re always like this when you want something from me…
translation: 每次你想从我这里得到什么时，都是这个样子……

source: If it weren’t for the other people out there at the bath, I would’ve given it to you already.
translation: 如果不是外面澡堂里还有其他人，我早就已经给你了。

source: I-I don’t know what you’re talking about sir…!
translation: 我、我不知道你在说什么，先生……！

source: There’s no use denying it. The moment I stood up from the pool, your bulge did the same.
translation: 否认没有用。刚才我从池子里站起来时，你的凸起也做了同样的事。

source: G-GAH…! S-Sorry, sir!
translation: 啊——！对、对不起，先生！

source: You think after all these years, I don’t know when you’re in the mood?
translation: 你以为过了这么多年，我还不知道你什么时候有这种心情吗？

source: Hngh… I couldn’t help it… It’s been in my head since we got here…
translation: 嗯啊……我也没办法……从我们来到这里开始，这就一直在我脑子里……

source: Heh... That’s exactly why I brought you here.
translation: 呵……所以我才带你来这里。

source: Wh-What?! Y-You planned this all along, sir?
translation: 什、什么？！你、你从一开始就计划好了，先生？

source: Well, I would’ve liked to get to this point sooner. But I admit I got a bit carried away with the small talk.
translation: 嗯，我本来想早点到这一步。不过我承认，闲聊时有点得意忘形了。

source: It was entertaining seeing how long you could keep yourself calm~
translation: 看你能保持冷静多久很有意思~

source: It was entertaining seeing how long you could keep yourself calm~{fast}
translation: 看你能保持冷静多久很有意思~{fast}

translation: 不出所料……这里同样棒。和我们房间一样，也有那种如画的景色。

translation: 啊，是的。我和Yoshinori刚才在附近逛，决定来吃顿饭。

source: Hihi~ Isn’t the view here amazing?
translation: 嘻嘻~这里的景色不是很棒吗？

translation: 来，看看我正在读的这些同人小说吧~！谁知道呢，说不定很合你的口味~？

translation: 天哪，Yoshi！你这个年纪不该知道吗？！你到底住在什么落后的地方？！

translation: 它代表束缚与纪律、施虐与受虐，以及臣服与支配。

translation: 这是常识，你知道的！

source: It sounds like a lot, and I feel like I should be concerned…
translation: 听起来内容很多，我觉得自己应该担心……

translation: 那么，其中有没有哪个让你产生兴趣？

translation: *叹气* 我真的必须选吗？

translation: 只是理论上……Yoshinori，你觉得自己会愿意接受哪一种？

translation: 只是理论上……Yoshinori，你觉得自己会愿意接受哪一种？{fast}

source: From the options, I guess… dominance? Being in control would be a bit new for me though.
translation: 这些选项里，我想……支配？掌控一切对我来说确实有点新鲜。

translation: 是啊……我很少见你主动掌控局面，Yoshi。

source: Just leave that to the expert.
translation: 交给专家就好。

source: From the options, I guess… sadism and masochism? But that just sounds dark…
translation: 这些选项里，我想……施虐与受虐？但听起来有点黑暗……

source: Ooohh~ I didn’t know you had it in you, Yoshi~
translation: 哦哦~我没想到你还有这方面，Yoshi~

source: As long as there’s no actual pain involved.
translation: 只要不涉及真正的疼痛。

source: From the options, I guess… bondage and discipline? I’m not sure I know what I’m talking about…
translation: 这些选项里，我想……束缚与纪律？我不确定自己是否真的明白……

source: That’s interesting. Notes taken.
translation: 有意思。记下了。

source: From the options, I guess… submission? That’s mostly how I am, right...?
translation: 这些选项里，我想……臣服？我大概就是这样，对吧……？

source: Yeaahhh, that’s what I thought for you too, Yoshi.
translation: 是啊，我也觉得你是这样，Yoshi。

source: Just the way it should be.
translation: 这才是应该的样子。

source: W-Well, should we really be talking about something like this in a public café...?
translation: 我、我们真的要在公共咖啡馆里讨论这种事吗……？

source: Psssh, no one cares~! Besides, I don’t ever get a chance to talk about my hobbies to the two of you without getting scolded.
translation: 嘘——没人会在意~！再说，我难得有机会在不被你们训斥的情况下和你们两个聊我的爱好。

source: Well, you know I always support your interests, Yuri. As long as you don’t get over-excited about them and faint.
translation: 不过你知道，我一直支持你的兴趣，Yuri。只要你别因为太兴奋而晕倒。

source: But that’s exactly the magic of it – BL itself is such an amazing artform~!
translation: 但那正是它的魅力——BL 本身就是一种惊人的艺术形式~！

source: With so many different mediums it could be presented in, you can really appreciate the creative process involved in making it!
translation: 它可以通过这么多不同媒介呈现，你真的能欣赏创作过程中的心血！

source: Oh, right… A lot of what you read includes pictures too, right?
translation: 哦，对了……你读的很多作品也包含图片，对吧？

source: It takes a lot of skill to write a script, let alone visualize it with hand-drawn illustrations!
translation: 写剧本本身就需要很多技巧，更不用说还要用手绘插图把它视觉化！

source: When you think about it… that does sound like a lot of work…
translation: 仔细想想……确实听起来工作量很大……

source: Yeah! Some people usually take these things for granted, when in fact the author puts weeks and even months into creating something so amazing.
translation: 是啊！很多人通常把这些事视为理所当然，但其实作者会投入几周甚至几个月，创作出如此精彩的作品。

source: Trust me, I’ve tried it myself and it’s just not for me, so I stick to appreciating it instead.
translation: 相信我，我自己也试过，但这不适合我，所以我还是专心欣赏。

source: Yuri’s always been the artistic type. It’s why she often leads similar activities with the scouts.
translation: Yuri一直是艺术型的人。这也是她经常带童子军做类似活动的原因。

source: Oh yeah… Everything makes so much more sense now.
translation: 哦，是啊……现在一切都说得通了。

source: Well, BL to me is more than just the art!
translation: 不过对我来说，BL 不只是艺术！

source: I find the genre itself so special! Seeing two men allowing themselves to be vulnerable and passionate towards each other, never fails to light a fire in me that words can’t explain!
translation: 我觉得这个类型本身就很特别！看着两个男人允许自己对彼此展现脆弱与激情，总能点燃一种语言无法解释的火焰！

source: It’s so wildly different from the idea I had of relationships, especially after what I saw growing up.
translation: 这和我从小看到的关系观念大不相同。

source: But flipping through these pages… I only see good-looking men… with no clothes… and LOTS of fluids.
translation: 但翻过这些页面……我只看到长得好看的男人……没穿衣服……还有大量液体。

source: Hmm… I guess I can appreciate how much work was put into this… even the way the genitals are drawn are very detailed.
translation: 嗯……我能欣赏其中投入了多少工作……甚至连生殖器的画法都非常细致。

source: Th-That just sounds painful…
translation: 这听起来就很疼……

source: Sure, I’ll give it a read, dear.
translation: 好，我会读读看，亲爱的。

source: Yay! You better tell me what you think about it, promise?!
translation: 好耶！你一定要告诉我感想，保证？！

source: And who knows, maybe you’ll break your decade-long single curse, Dad!
translation: 谁知道呢，也许你能打破长达十年的单身诅咒，爸爸！

source: {i}We ended up sitting and talking with Yuri about her fanfics for a long time, all while eating our meal.{/i}

source: {i}Before we realized, the sun had already set, and we decided to check out another area of the hotel for the evening! {/i}
translation: {i}等我们意识到时，太阳已经落山了，于是决定晚上去看看酒店的另一个区域！ {/i}

source: {i}Before we realized, it had gotten late, so we headed back to our room to call it a night. {/i}
translation: {i}等我们意识到时，天已经很晚了，所以我们回到房间，准备结束这一天。 {/i}

source: Now, that I’m recharged, maybe we should check out the gym, sir?
translation: 现在我充满电了，也许我们该去看看健身房，先生？

source: Hehe… Are you sure your body can handle it?
translation: 嘿嘿……你确定身体吃得消吗？

source: Alright then, don’t say I didn’t warn you.
translation: 好吧，那别说我没提醒你。

source: Oh, I want to check the gym out, sir!
translation: 哦，我想去看看健身房，先生！

source: Sure thing, Yoshinori. We’ll sweat even more before the day’s over, heh.
translation: 当然，Yoshinori。在今天结束前我们还能再出点汗，嘿。

source: Wow… Check out all the fancy equipment they have here!
translation: 哇……看看这里所有的高级设备！

source: Makes me wish we had our own setup back at camp. We mostly stay in shape with only body workouts and a couple of weights.
translation: 真希望营地也有自己的器材。我们主要靠自重训练和几副哑铃保持身材。

source: I kinda wanna try some of them!
translation: 我有点想试试其中一些！

source: Are you sure you want to push your muscles even further today?
translation: 你确定今天还要进一步锻炼肌肉？

source: I-It should be fine, sir! I think…
translation: 这、这应该没问题，先生！我想……

translation: 好吧，慢慢来，行吗？你到底打算锻炼什么？

translation: 那么，你打算锻炼哪个部位？

translation: 我有点想让自己的腹肌像你的一样好，Goro先生……

source: Heh… I know you like to ogle mine. They’re pretty strong and solid to the touch too.
translation: 呵……我知道你喜欢盯着我的看。它们摸起来也很结实有力。

source: I pay attention.
translation: 我有在注意。

source: Well, I figured I should return the favor and distract you too, sir.
translation: 嗯，我想我应该回报你一下，也让你分心，先生。

source: Hahaha! Teasing doesn’t suit you, Yoshinori.
translation: 哈哈哈！捉弄人不适合你，Yoshinori。

source: H-Hey…!
Well, if you really to want to give me a show, then start working out.
translation: 如果你真的想给我表演，那就开始锻炼吧。

translation: 我会看着。

translation: 我想试试推胸机？它主要锻炼胸肌！

translation: 呵……我的胸肌很大，你还要花一段时间才能达到这个程度。

source: Well, I think it’d be nice to be able to bounce them a little bit!
translation: 我想能让它们稍微弹起来一定很不错！

source: Hahaha, do you want to give me something to gawk at so badly?
translation: 哈哈哈，你就这么想给我点值得看的东西吗？

source: W-Well… It’s not fair that I’m the only who gets teased around you, sir.
translation: 嗯……你在身边的时候，只有我被逗弄，这不公平，先生。

source: I want to try this curl machine! It looks like it focuses on my arms!
translation: 我想试试这个弯举机！看起来主要锻炼手臂！

source: Besides, your arms look great as they are.
translation: 再说，你的手臂本来就很棒。

source: Maybe one day, I’ll be able to lift you too, sir.
translation: 也许有一天，我也能把你举起来，先生。

source: Hah, is that a challenge?
translation: 哈，这是在挑战我吗？

source: *ehem* I-I guess I’ll go ahead and start.
translation: *呃咳* 我、我想我这就开始。

source: Oh~?

translation: 我倒是不介意有更大的屁股可以拍。

source: G-GAH…!

translation: 什么？我只是说说。

source: *sigh* You’re really enjoying teasing me today, huh, sir?
translation: *叹气* 你今天真的很享受逗我，对吧，先生？

source: It’s not my fault you make it so easy for me.
translation: 这可不是我的错，谁让你这么容易逗。

source: Hold on a moment, Yoshinori. Is that Lloyd over there?
translation: 等一下，Yoshinori。那边是不是Lloyd？

source: Oh, I think so! Looks like he’s headed into that private room… Wonder what he’s up to?
translation: 哦，我想是！看起来他要进那间私人房……不知道他要做什么？

translation: 和Lloyd聊天

translation: 加入Lloyd的锻炼 (DLC)

source: Sir Goro!
translation: Goro先生！

source: Oh, you’re with Yoshi too!
translation: 哦，你和Yoshi也在！

source: Hello, Lloyd. Looking fit today.
translation: 你好，Lloyd。今天看起来状态不错。

source: Thanks, sir! I just finished doing some yoga~. You know I don’t skip a day of my routine!
translation: 谢谢，先生！我刚做完瑜伽~你知道我一天都不会跳过日常训练！

source: Looks like you guys are working out too, huh?
translation: 看来你们也在锻炼，对吧？

source: Yeah! We’re just about to start, though!
translation: 是啊！不过我们正要开始！

source: I’m surprised Darius isn’t with you.
translation: 我很惊讶Darius没和你一起。

source: Oh, he’s actually on his way here! Maybe he’s in the changing room by now!
translation: 哦，他其实正在过来的路上！现在可能已经在更衣室了！

source: It’s really rare to see you two apart. You guys are usually stuck together like glue!
translation: 很少看到你们两个分开。你们平时总是形影不离！

source: I agree. Ever since the first term, you two have had one of the closest bonds amongst all the scouts.
translation: 我同意。自从第一期活动以来，你们两个一直是所有童子军中关系最亲密的之一。

source: Well, I don’t know how to explain it, ’cause Dar’s pretty much the opposite of me.
translation: 不过，我不知道该怎么解释，因为Dar基本上和我完全相反。

source: The only thing we had in common back then is how we were both sort of outcasts.
translation: 那时我们唯一的共同点，就是都多少算是局外人。

source: This was before we all became roommates, right?
translation: 这是在我们成为室友之前，对吧？

source: Yeah. I’m sure you guys remember how I was way too excitable in my younger days.
translation: 是啊。我相信你们还记得我年轻时有多容易兴奋。

source: And let’s just say some of the other scouts found me and my hobbies kinda annoying.
translation: 只能说，其他一些童子军觉得我和我的爱好有点烦人。

source: Nobody took me seriously because of it. And it doesn’t help that I’m short AF too.
translation: 因此没人认真对待我。而且我的身高也他妈矮，这更糟。

source: As your scoutmaster, I feel bad I didn’t know about all this…
translation: 作为你的童子军团长，我很抱歉以前不知道这些……

source: Nah, Sir Goro! It’s just how things are with immature teenagers.
translation: 不，Goro先生！不成熟的青少年就是这样。

source: Besides, if it weren’t for that, I wouldn’t have gotten close to Dar.
translation: 再说，如果不是那样，我也不会和Dar亲近。

source: The other scouts used to stay away from him because of how quiet he was.
translation: 其他童子军过去总是因为他太安静而躲着他。

source: Everyone just assumes he’s either intimidating or uninteresting, which wasn’t really fair ’cause they didn’t even try to get to know him!
translation: 大家都觉得他要么吓人，要么无趣，但这真的不公平，因为他们甚至没试着了解他！

source: All I needed to do was approach him, and everything just clicked since then!
translation: 我只要主动接近他，从那以后我们一拍即合！

source: Darius is really lucky he has you, Lloyd.
translation: Darius有你真幸运，Lloyd。

source: No way! I’m actually the lucky one here!
translation: 才不是！其实是我更幸运！

source: He always listens to everything I have to say, and you guys know I run my mouth a lot.
translation: 他总是听我说完每件事，而你们也知道我很爱唠叨。

source: And when it comes to my interests, he always tries to enjoy them with me! Even though he does like to tease me about them still…
translation: 说到我的兴趣，他总是试着和我一起享受！尽管他还是喜欢拿这些逗我……

source: Darius does like to tease.
translation: Darius确实喜欢逗你。

source: I don’t mind though! He always does his best to make me feel like I don’t have to change anything about myself!
translation: 不过我不介意！他总是尽力让我觉得自己不必改变任何地方！

source: Whether it’s my hyperness, my temper, or even my height! He accepts all of them!
translation: 不管是我的过度活跃、我的脾气，还是我的身高！他全都接受！

source: Heck, the reason why I’m even into yoga is because of him! He taught me how to find my ‘inner peace’!
translation: 说真的，我会喜欢瑜伽也是因为他！是他教会我如何找到“内心的平静”！

source: That’s an amazing thing to hear, Lloyd. I’m sure Darius feels the same about you.
translation: 听到这些真好，Lloyd。我相信Darius对你也是同样的感受。

source: Boo.
GAHH! You startled me, Dar!
translation: 啊——！你吓到我了，Dar！

source: Hehe. I heard my name.
translation: 嘿嘿。我听到有人叫我的名字。

source: Were you talking about me, Lloyd?
translation: 你们在谈论我吗，Lloyd？

source: Nope! You didn’t hear anything!
translation: 才没有！你什么都没听到！

source: Come on, Dar! it’s time to do some yoga! Bye, guys!
translation: 来吧，Dar！该做瑜伽了！再见，大家！

source: Didn’t Lloyd say he was done with yoga?
translation: Lloyd不是说他已经做完瑜伽了吗？

source: Hahaha, he looked really embarrassed.
translation: 哈哈哈，他看起来真的很尴尬。

source: However, I must admit, I feel like a proud father seeing those two like this…
translation: 不过我必须承认，看到他们这样，我感觉自己像个自豪的父亲……

source: That made you sound really old, sir… and cheesy.
translation: 这让你听起来真的很老，先生……而且很俗气。

source: *ehem* We got sidetracked.
translation: *呃咳* 我们跑题了。

source: Back to our workout!
translation: 回去锻炼！

source: {i}We spent the rest of the afternoon working out until we realized the sun had already set.{/i}
translation: {i}我们下午剩下的时间都在锻炼，直到发现太阳已经落山。{/i}

source: {i}We decided to finish up, take a quick shower, and check out another place in the hotel for the evening.{/i}
translation: {i}我们决定结束锻炼，快速洗个澡，晚上再去看看酒店的另一个地方。{/i}

source: {i}We spent the rest of the evening working out until we realized it was already late.{/i}
translation: {i}我们整个晚上都在锻炼，直到发现天已经很晚了。{/i}

source: {i}We decided to finish up, take a quick shower, and head back to our room to call it a night.{/i}
translation: {i}我们决定结束锻炼，快速洗个澡，回房间结束这一天。{/i}

source: Maybe we should check on what the others are doing?
translation: 也许我们该看看其他人在做什么？

source: I don’t mind. Maybe they’re up to something interesting.
translation: 我不介意。也许他们在做什么有趣的事。

source: I don’t mind. It’s almost the end of the day anyway.
translation: 我不介意。反正一天也快结束了。

source: Hm? Where’s Yuri? Shouldn’t she be with you?
translation: 嗯？Yuri呢？她不是应该和你在一起吗？

source: G-Gah, I’m sorry, sir! I couldn’t keep her under control!
translation: 啊——对不起，先生！我没能管住她！

source: Oh, you’re not in trouble. I was just wondering why you stayed in. There’s so much to do out there.
translation: 哦，你没有惹麻烦。我只是好奇你为什么留在房间里。外面有这么多事情可以做。

source: I-It’s alright. sir! I’m not really the type to go out and party. I’m fine just staying in a cozy room like this!
translation: 没、没关系，先生！我不是那种喜欢出去参加派对的人。就待在这样舒适的房间里，我就很满足了。

source: Oh no, do you still feel a little sick?
translation: 哦，不，你还是有点不舒服吗？

source: Oh no, do you still feel sick from the bus ride this morning?
translation: 哦，不，你还在因为今天早上的巴士旅程感到不舒服吗？

source: Are you alright in here by yourself?
translation: 你一个人在这里还好吗？

source: Oh, yes! I’ll be fine… Honestly, I prefer to stay in the room anyway.
translation: 哦，是的！我会没事的……说实话，我本来就更喜欢待在房间里。

source: Really? Why’s that?
translation: 真的？为什么？

source: W-Well, I’m not really used to going on trips with a large group, and I’m not actually sure what to do…
translation: 嗯、嗯……我不太习惯和一大群人旅行，而且我其实也不知道该做什么……

source: Hmmm, I suppose a vacation with tons of options like this could be a bit overwhelming.
translation: 嗯……我想，像这样有大量选择的假期可能会让人有点不知所措。

source: Maybe something a little more outdoorsy and natural would have suited you better.
translation: 也许更偏户外、更贴近自然的地方会更适合你。

source: Oh, you mean like our beach trip, sir?
translation: 哦，你是指我们的海滩旅行吗，先生？

source: Ah, that’s right, you weren’t here last term, Jin. Yes, we took the campers to the beach for a few days during the summer this year.
translation: 啊，对了，Jin，你上一期活动不在。没错，今年夏天我们带营员去海滩玩了几天。

source: Getting into a swimsuit with the summer sun and ocean breeze was quite relaxing.
translation: 穿着泳衣，在夏日阳光和海风中放松，感觉很不错。

source: W-What?! Sir Goro… in a SKIMPY SWIMSUIT?!
translation: 什、什么？！Goro先生……穿着暴露的泳衣？！

source: I-I wouldn’t say skimpy, but it was definitely tiny enough to be distracting…
translation: 我、我不会说暴露，但确实小得足以让人分心……

source: *ehem* Well, if it weren’t for you lei-ing me, it would’ve been too distracting for the scouts.
translation: *呃咳* 嗯，如果不是你给我编花环，对童子军来说确实会太分心。

source: W-What?! LAYING?! You have to tell me the details, right now!
translation: 什、什么？！躺下？！你现在就得告诉我细节！

source: Don’t get the wrong idea, Jin. I assure you it’s safe enough that you could maybe even use it for that journal project of yours.
translation: 别误会，Jin。我保证它足够安全，说不定你甚至可以把它用在你的日记项目里。

source: I-Is it, though sir…? I don’t think that’s appropriate for-
translation: 这、这真的吗，先生……？我觉得那不适合——

source: Looks like we’re invested now, Yoshinori.
translation: 看来我们现在都很投入了，Yoshinori。

source: *sigh* I guess we’re doing this…
translation: *叹气* 看来我们要继续了……

source: Come on, Yoshi! We already setup the campsite, what the heck else do ya gotta do?!
translation: 来吧，Yoshi！我们已经把营地搭好了，你到底还要做什么啊？！

source: Oh, it’s nothing major, Aiden! I’m just crafting something!
translation: 哦，没什么大事，Aiden！我只是在做手工！

source: You can go on ahead without me.
translation: 你先走吧，不用等我。

source: Sheesh, Yoshi… Shouldn’t you be taking it easy? The sportsfest is over, and we’re on vacation! We should be relaxing!
translation: 拜托，Yoshi……你不是应该休息吗？运动会都结束了，我们还在度假！应该放松一下！

source: Well, this is the first time Sir Goro has gone on a trip with us in a while, and I just want to make sure he has a great time!
translation: 这是Goro先生最近一段时间以来第一次和我们一起旅行，我只是想确保他玩得开心！

source: He’s been really satisfied with all of our progress so far, and I want to keep the streak going.
translation: 到目前为止，他对我们的进展非常满意，我想保持这股势头。

source: *sigh* You’re always so worried about what Gramps will think of us… But then again, I guess it can’t be helped.
translation: *叹气* 你总是这么担心Gramps会怎么看我们……不过话说回来，我想也没办法。

source: He HAS been a crank-o-potamus for years after all!
translation: 他这些年确实一直是个暴躁老顽固！

source: *ehem* I’m sure Sir Goro is just going through a lot. Which is exactly why I want to use this trip as a chance for him to destress!
translation: *呃咳* 我相信Goro先生只是经历了很多。这正是我想利用这次旅行让他放松压力的原因！

source: Alright, fine… Guess I could go and start doing a little prepwork for lunch before I swim.
translation: 好吧，行……我可以先去为午餐做点准备，然后再去游泳。

source: Maybe some fresh fish’ll lighten his mood too!
translation: 也许一些新鲜鱼肉也能改善他的心情！

source: That sounds great, Aiden! I’ll help you catch some as soon as I’m done here!
translation: 听起来不错，Aiden！我忙完这里就帮你抓一些！

source: Sure thing, Yoshi.
translation: 没问题，Yoshi。

source: Let’s see…. The flowers go here…
translation: 让我看看……花要放在这里……

source: Is someone in the bushes…?
translation: 灌木丛里有人吗……？

source: GAH! S-Sir?!
translation: 啊！先、先生？！

source: W-What are you doing here, Sir Goro?!
translation: Goro先生，你在这里做什么？！

source: Hmph, I should be asking you. I didn’t expect you to try and sneak up on me while I’m getting dressed.
translation: 哼，我才该问你。我没想到你会在我换衣服时偷偷靠近。

source: A-Ack! I didn’t know sir… I thought you’d be getting dressed in your tent.
translation: 啊、糟！我不知道，先生……我以为你会在帐篷里换衣服。

source: Well, I would normally, but Yuri’s not comfortable with me changing in there.
translation: 通常我会，但Yuri不喜欢我在里面换。

source: It’s just easier if I do it out here.
translation: 我在外面换更方便。

source: Oh? Something catch your eye?
translation: 哦？有什么吸引你的目光吗？

source: Uhh….
GAH! W-What is it, sir?
translation: 啊！先、先生，怎么了？

source: If you want to ogle my body, you could at least try and be a little more subtle about it.
translation: 如果你想盯着我的身体看，至少可以稍微含蓄一点。

source: S-Sorry, sir…! I didn’t mean to!
translation: 对、对不起，先生……！我不是故意的！

source: *sigh* I can’t really blame you… Even this shirt is several sizes too small.
translation: *叹气* 我也不能真怪你……连这件衬衫都小了好几个尺码。

source: Yuri is terrible at picking out what I wear – she’s never paid attention to my body type, after all.
translation: Yuri挑衣服很差——毕竟她从没注意过我的体型。

source: *gulp* T-That explains the suit as well…
translation: *咽口水* 这、这也解释了那套衣服……

source: Heh, watch where you’re looking.
translation: 呵，注意你的视线。

source: I, uh…
translation: 我，呃……

source: Anyway, what do you have in your hand there?
translation: 话说，你手里拿的是什么？

source: O-Oh, this? It’s actually a flower necklace I was making!
translation: 哦、哦，这个？其实是我正在做的花环！

source: Huh… I’d forgotten how delicate you can be when it comes to crafting.
translation: 嗯……我都忘了你做手工时可以这么细致。

source: W-Well, I owe that to all the badges I’ve hand-knitted over the years.
translation: 这、这要归功于这些年我手工编织的徽章。

source: But I actually made this one for you, sir!
translation: 但这个其实是我为你做的，先生！

source: …Really? What for?
translation: ……真的吗？为什么？

source: I know how busy you’ve been, and how rare it is for us to get to spend a vacation together, so…
translation: 我知道你一直很忙，我们很少有机会一起度假，所以……

source: I thought it’d be a great way to welcome you back for the trip!
translation: 我想这会是欢迎你回来参加这次旅行的好方式！

source: Y-You don’t have to wear it though, sir! I know it’s a bit different from your style-
translation: 你、你不用戴，先生！我知道它和你的风格有点不同——

source: I’ll take it.
translation: 我收下了。

source: Matches my getup, anyways.
translation: 反正和我的装扮很配。

source: I-It really does, sir… It looks good on you…!
translation: 确、确实很配，先生……戴在你身上很好看……！

source: *ehem* Thank you, Yoshinori.
translation: *呃咳* 谢谢你，Yoshinori。

source: You’re welcome, sir! I’m so glad you like it!
translation: 不客气，先生！我很高兴你喜欢！

source: A-Anyway, I’ll get back to my other duties, and let you-
translation: 那、那我回去继续做其他事，让你——

source: Hold on, Yoshinori.
translation: 等等，Yoshinori。

source: O-Oh, what is it, sir?
translation: 哦、哦，怎么了，先生？

source: You’re not just going to leave with unfinished business, are you?
translation: 你不会打算就这样留下未完成的事吧？

source: Wh-What are you trying to say, sir…?
translation: 你、你想说什么，先生……？

source: You’re the one who just ‘leid’ me – don’t you think I should return the favor?
translation: 刚才是你给我“戴上花环”的——你不觉得我应该回报你吗？

source: W-WHAT?!
translation: 什、什么？！

source: Don’t act so innocent, Yoshinori – We both know why you’ve been staring at me this whole time.
translation: 别装得这么无辜，Yoshinori——我们都知道你为什么一直盯着我。

source: And don’t think I haven’t noticed that bulge in your shorts.
translation: 别以为我没注意到你短裤里的凸起。

source: You’re not the only one who wants to get off here, Yoshinori.
translation: 这里想要解脱的可不只有你，Yoshinori。

source: Now, get on your knees.
translation: 现在，跪下。

source: *gulp* Y-Yes, sir…!
translation: *咽口水* 是、是的，先生……！

source: {i}Following Sir Goro’s command, I knelt on the ground and began to pull down his suit…{/i}
translation: {i}按照Goro先生的命令，我跪在地上，开始脱下他的衣服……{/i}

source: You know, it was probably a good thing you brought me to the water, sir, or there would’ve been no way to clean up that mess.
translation: 你知道吗，幸好你把我带到水边，先生，否则根本没办法收拾那一团乱。

source: Not me. I felt relaxed for the entire day after.
translation: 不是我。我之后一整天都很放松。

source: I can’t even imagine what would’ve happened if the scouts or Aiden caught us… Or worse, Yuri…
translation: 我根本不敢想象要是童子军或Aiden撞见我们会怎样……更糟的是Yuri……

source: *ehem* I’d prefer not to think about that, Yoshinori.
translation: *呃咳* 我不想去想那个，Yoshinori。

source: Uhh… We might’ve overloaded him again, sir…
translation: 呃……我们可能又把他弄得精疲力竭了，先生……

source: Uhh… Look at his pants.
translation: 呃……看看他的裤子。

source: I have to go… to the bathroom…
translation: 我得走了……去……厕所……

source: Seems he was really having stomach issues.
translation: 看起来他的胃确实出了问题。

source: *sigh* But it looks like he didn’t even write anything down on his laptop.
translation: *叹气* 但他好像甚至没在笔记本电脑上写下任何东西。

source: Perhaps I can check on him in the bathroom and see if I can help anything with his gagging…
translation: 也许我可以去厕所看看他，帮他处理干呕……

source: {i}As we left Jin to rest, we suddenly realized that the sun had already set.{/i}
translation: {i}我们让Jin休息，突然意识到太阳已经落山了。{/i}

source: {i}We decided to go check out another area of the hotel before it got too late.{/i}
translation: {i}我们决定在天太晚之前去看看酒店的另一个区域。{/i}

source: {i}As we left Jin to rest, we suddenly realized how late it was, and decided to head back to our own room and call it a night.{/i}
translation: {i}我们让Jin休息时，突然意识到天已经很晚了，于是决定回自己的房间结束这一天。{/i}

source: Let’s go back to the lobby, sir!
translation: 我们回大厅吧，先生！

source: There’s not much to see there, but I guess it’ll help kill some time.
translation: 那里没什么可看的，不过应该能帮我们消磨时间。

source: Hmm… Let me ask the receptionist if there any events for tonight.
translation: 嗯……我去问问接待员今晚有没有活动。

source: Oh, wait! Isn’t that Emilia over there?
translation: 哦，等等！那边是不是Emilia？

source: Huh… I thought she’d be in her room… I hope she’s not causing a commotion again.
translation: 嗯……我以为她会在房间里……希望她没有又在惹事。

source: Maybe I should check just to make sure she doesn’t.
translation: 也许我该去确认一下，确保她没有惹麻烦。

source: Wait… Don’t tell me you’re going to talk to her?
translation: 等等……你不会打算去和她说话吧？

source: I promise I’ll be quick, sir.
translation: 我保证很快就回来，先生。

source: *sigh* Fine.
translation: *叹气* 好吧。

source: I knew that was a bad idea.
translation: 我就知道这是个坏主意。

source: I know we’re supposed to work on our relationship with her, especially after what happened yesterday.
translation: 我知道我们应该改善和她的关系，尤其是在昨天发生了那件事之后。

source: But I don’t think she’s ready to have that conversation yet.
translation: 但我不觉得她已经准备好谈那件事了。

source: Ah, I’m sorry, sir! I didn't mean to dig so deeply into it.
translation: 啊，对不起，先生！我不是想把话题挖得这么深。

source: Alright, let’s decide where we should go next!
translation: 好了，我们决定接下来去哪儿吧！

source: Let’s just head back to our room and call it a night.
translation: 我们还是回房间结束这一天吧。

source: Yes, sir…
translation: 好的，先生……

source: Oh, how about we head over to the bar, sir?
translation: 哦，不如我们去酒吧吧，先生？

source: Heh, I was hoping you’d say that. Let’s go.
translation: 呵，我就希望你这么说。走吧。

source: Sounds like the perfect way to end the day. Let’s go.
translation: 听起来是结束一天的完美方式。走吧。

source: Whoa… This place looks cozy!
translation: 哇……这里看起来很舒适！

source: I bet it’s completely different at night.
translation: 我敢说晚上这里完全不一样。

source: Maybe it’s a lot more like a club than a casual pub…
translation: 也许这里比休闲酒馆更像俱乐部……

source: Whoa! This place looks lively…!
translation: 哇！这里看起来真热闹……！

source: Nothing like the bars we go to back home, huh?
translation: 和我们老家去的酒吧完全不一样，对吧？

source: Yeah, this place is a lot more like a club than a casual pub…
translation: 是啊，这里比休闲酒馆更像俱乐部……

source: Definitely, especially with all of these entertainers.
translation: 当然，尤其还有这么多表演者。

source: Ah, yes. Can we have the menu please?
translation: 啊，是的。可以给我们菜单吗？

source: Here you go, sir!
translation: 给您，先生！

source: Hmmm…
translation: 嗯嗯……

source: Whoa… I only recognize a few of these drinks, sir…
translation: 哇……这些饮料里我只认识几种，先生……

source: I would usually have whiskey. But with how many options there are, it’d be a shame to not try something new.
translation: 我平时会喝威士忌。不过选择这么多，不试试新东西就太可惜了。

source: Heh, how about you pick for the two of us, Yoshinori?
translation: 呵，要不你替我们两个选，Yoshinori？

source: {i}(Looking at the options… Sir Goro would like…){/i}
translation: {i}（看着这些选项……Goro先生会喜欢……）{/i}

source: {i}(Looking at the options… Sir Goro would like…){/i}{fast}
translation: {i}（看着这些选项……Goro先生会喜欢……）{/i}{fast}

source: Liquid Viagra.
translation: 液体伟哥。

source: I think we could use some ‘Liquid Viagra’!
translation: 我觉得我们可以来点“液体伟哥”！

source: It’s a simple mix of digestif and energy drink!
translation: 只是消化酒和能量饮料的简单混合物！

source: Hard pass.
translation: 坚决不要。

source: How about we order your specialty mix instead?
translation: 不如点你的特色混合酒？

source: Magical! Two ‘Sailor Moan’, coming up!
translation: 神奇！两杯“水手呻吟”，马上来！

source: Huh… I’m not sure I’d be into that.
translation: 嗯……我不确定我会喜欢那个。

source: It’s a simple mix of coffee and vodka!
translation: 不过就是咖啡兑伏特加！

source: I like coffee. I like alcohol. But not together.
translation: 我喜欢咖啡，也喜欢酒，但不喜欢把它们混在一起。

source: Cocksucking Cowboy.
translation: 吮茎牛仔。

source: You like a ‘Cocksucking Cowboy’, right sir?
translation: 先生，你喜欢“吮茎牛仔”，对吧？

source: Heh, that sounds like a mouthful.
translation: 呵，听起来内容很足。

source: Butterscotch, schnapps, and a whole lotta cream…
translation: 奶油糖甜酒，再加上一大堆奶油……

source: Alright~ Two ‘Cocksucking Cowboys’, coming up!
translation: 好~两杯“吮茎牛仔”，马上来！

source: Leg Spreader.
translation: 劈腿者。

source: Sounds like you’d enjoy a ‘Leg Spreader’, sir!
translation: 听起来你会喜欢“劈腿者”，先生！

source: Heh, you know me well.
translation: 呵，你很了解我。

source: Tequila, vodka, gin, and rum all together. A total homewrecker.
translation: 龙舌兰、伏特加、金酒和朗姆酒全混在一起。这一杯下去，家都别想回了。

source: Alright~ A pair of ‘Leg Spreaders’ coming up!
translation: 好~一对“劈腿者”，马上来！

source: While you wait, we’ll send over our hottest, newest entertainer to your table! Be right back!
translation: 等候期间，我们会把最火、最新的表演者送到你们桌边！马上回来！

source: Uhh… I don’t think we—
translation: 呃……我觉得我们不——

source: Hey there~! Wanna have some fun toni-
translation: 你好~！今晚想不想找点乐子——

source: AIDEN?!
translation: Aiden？！

source: WAH! Gramps, Yoshi! What are you two doing here?!
translation: 哇！Gramps、Yoshi！你们两个怎么在这里？！

source: W-We should be the ones asking you that…!!
translation: 我、我们才该问你吧……！！

source: Good heavens, Aiden…  Even out here, you can’t keep a shirt on?
translation: 天哪，Aiden……在外面你也不能穿上衣吗？

source: Well, my boss said that’s the dress code around here~
translation: 我的老板说这里的着装要求就是这样~

source: What? First of all, I’m your boss. Second of all, you don’t work here!
translation: 什么？首先，我是你的老板。其次，你根本不在这里工作！

source: It’s only a one-night gig, Gramps! They said I could get all those fancy drinks I can’t pronounce in exchange!
translation: 只是做一晚的临时工作，Gramps！他们说可以用那些我叫不出名字的高级饮料作为报酬！

source: ’Cause holy fuck, did you guys see how crazy the prices are? It’s more than my daily salary!
translation: 我操，你们看到价格有多离谱了吗？比我一天的工资还高！

source: *sigh* We’re on vacation, Aiden. Sit your ass here and drink with us. I’m paying.
translation: *叹气* 我们在度假，Aiden。坐到这里和我们喝，我买单。

source: WOOOHOOO! Don’t mind if I do, sugar daddy!
translation: 哇哦哦哦！我当然不介意，糖爹！

source: You’re drunk, aren’t you, Aiden?
translation: 你喝醉了，对吧，Aiden？

source: Yup! *burp*
translation: 对！*打嗝*

source: Well, it’s good to see you enjoying yourself at least. You’ve been working nonstop at camp, and I’m not talking about just on the project.
translation: 至少看到你玩得开心真不错。你一直在营地里不停工作，我说的不只是项目。

source: Oh, you bet! I’m having the time of my life here!
translation: 哦，那当然！我在这里玩得超开心！

source: I’m waiting for the entertainment later! I heard it’s gonna be a blast!
translation: 我在等晚点的表演！听说会非常精彩！

source: Wow! Like a live show?
translation: 哇！像现场表演？

source: Yep! You guys are free to join if you want! They said that audience interaction is welcome!
translation: 对！你们想来就可以加入！他们说欢迎观众互动！

source: Oh… It’s that kind of show…
translation: 哦……是那种表演……

source: I bet a lot of people would love to have a piece of Gramps over here! Even right now, a couple are checking him out!
translation: 我敢说很多人都想尝尝Gramps的滋味！你看，现在就有两个人在盯着他！

source: That event sounds more up your alley, Aiden.
translation: 那个活动听起来更适合你，Aiden。

source: Yep! I’m already booked for a VIP session later! Who knew you can make tons of cash off of it?!
translation: 对！我晚点已经被人包下VIP场了！谁知道这样也能赚这么多钱？！

source: WHAT?! Aiden, do you know what you’re getting yourself into?!
translation: 什么？！Aiden，你知道自己要做什么吗？！

source: Don’t worry! It’s just ‘look, don’t touch’, and I’ll keep my pants on!
translation: 别担心！只是“能看不能摸”，而且我会穿着裤子！

source: So, a tamer version of what you already do back at camp.
translation: 所以，是你们在营地做的那些事的温和版。

source: Although I wouldn’t mind getting some action too~
translation: 不过我也不介意自己找点乐子～

source: Hey there, Aiden! Your client’s looking for you!
translation: 嘿，Aiden！你的客人找你！

source: Ooh, that’s my cue, guys! Seeya!
translation: 哦，该我上场了，伙计们！回头见！

source: Aiden, wait—!
translation: Aiden，等等——！

source: He’s old enough, Yoshinori. Let the boy have a good time.
translation: 他已经成年了，Yoshinori。让这孩子好好玩吧。

source: *sigh* I guess…
translation: *叹气* 我想也是……

source: Well, I have your drinks ready now! Please enjoy!
translation: 好了，你们的饮料准备好了！请享用！

source: Cheers, Yoshinori.
translation: 干杯，Yoshinori。

source: {i}(We spent the rest of the evening enjoying our drinks and chatting casually.){/i}
translation: {i}剩下的晚上，我们一边享用饮料，一边随意聊天。{/i}

source: {i}(By the time it was dark out, we figured we’d stop before we got drunk so we can still check out other areas of the hotel.){/i}
translation: {i}天黑时，我们决定在醉倒之前先停下，这样还能继续看看酒店的其他区域。{/i}

source: {i}(We spent the rest of the night enjoying our drinks and chatting casually.){/i}
translation: {i}剩下的夜晚，我们一边享用饮料，一边随意聊天。{/i}

source: {i}(We decided to call it a night and stop before we got too drunk, and headed back to our room...){/i}
translation: {i}我们决定结束这一天，在醉得太厉害之前停下，然后回到房间……{/i}

source: Whew, I’m so beat…! It’s been a while since I had so much fun.
translation: 呼，我累坏了……！我已经很久没有这么开心了。

source: Yeah, me too. It’s a nice feeling compared to a long day of work.
translation: 是啊，我也是。和忙碌一天的工作相比，这感觉真不错。

source: I agree, sir. I’m ready for a good night sleep.
translation: 我同意，先生。我准备好好睡一觉了。

source: Come over and lay down here then. The bed’s really comfortable.
translation: 过来躺下吧。床很舒服。

source: Ah, well…
translation: 啊，这个嘛……

source: What? Don’t tell me you’re still thinking twice about sleeping with me.
translation: 什么？别告诉我你还在犹豫要不要和我一起睡。

source: You’ve already done way more than that with me today.
translation: 你今天和我做的事情已经远远不止这个了。

source: See? It’s big enough for the both of us.
translation: 看吧？足够我们两个一起睡。

source: I-I’m sorry I’ve been so antsy about it, sir.
translation: 对、对不起，先生，我一直对此坐立不安。

source: It’s just really hard to wrap my head around the fact we’re doing all of this together.
translation: 只是我们一起做这一切，实在让我很难理解。

source: Hopefully that’s not a bad thing.
translation: 希望这不是什么坏事。

source: Hopefully that’s not a bad thing.{fast}
translation: 希望这不是什么坏事。{fast}

source: It feels wrong.
translation: 这感觉不对。

source: I’m enjoying it so much that it almost feels wrong.
translation: 我太享受了，甚至觉得这不对劲。

source: Well, just don’t overthink it and enjoy the moment.
translation: 别想太多，享受这一刻。

source: It's different.
translation: 这不一样。

source: It’s just so different from our usual routine.
translation: 这和我们平时的生活太不一样了。

source: It feels familiar.
translation: 这感觉很熟悉。

source: Not at all, sir! Spending time with you feels so familiar.
translation: 完全不是，先生！和你相处的感觉非常熟悉。

source: It’s just like when I was a scout and everything was fresh and exciting!
translation: 就像我还是童子军时，一切都新鲜又令人兴奋！

source: Well, that’s how it’s supposed to be. Just enjoy the moment.
translation: 本来就应该这样。享受这一刻吧。

source: It brings me back.
translation: 这让我回到了过去。

source: Not at all, sir. It actually brings me back.
translation: 完全不是，先生。其实它让我回到了过去。

source: This’ll help you chill out. *hands over a glass of whiskey*
translation: 这能帮你放松。*递上一杯威士忌*

source: Whoa! Where did that drink come from?
translation: 哇！这杯酒是从哪里来的？

source: Hehe, our room has a mini-bar.
translation: 嘿嘿，我们的房间有迷你酒吧。

source: We’re gonna drink tonight, sir??
translation: 我们今晚要喝酒吗，先生？？

source: We’re gonna drink more, sir…?!
translation: 我们还要继续喝吗，先生……？！

source: Just to relax, until you feel sleepy.
translation: 只是为了放松，直到你感到困倦。

source: Look out the window, we’ve got a really pretty view of the city at night.
translation: 看看窗外，夜晚的城市景色真漂亮。

source: One day, I’ll be able to take you to newer places. So, get used to the new sights.
translation: 总有一天，我会带你去更新奇的地方。所以，习惯一下新的景色吧。

source: I-I’d like that, sir…
translation: 我、我会喜欢的，先生……

source: {i}After such an eventful day, Sir Goro and I managed to spend a really peaceful night together.{/i}
translation: {i}经历了充实的一天后，Goro先生和我一起度过了一个非常宁静的夜晚。{/i}

source: {i}With the alcohol warming my system, I eventually fell asleep without even realizing it.{/i}
translation: {i}酒精温暖着我的身体，我最终甚至没有意识到自己就睡着了。{/i}
